features.pending: 'chưa xác thực thì không mua được gói' through the real checkout: an unverified learner opens a plan, tries to pay and is refused; after verifying, the same order goes through. Today the rule is asserted at UserDirectory#requireVerified (via the seed API) and in the banner.

'AUTHOR IELTS không thấy/không sửa được câu TOEIC' and 'REVIEWER không duyệt được bản mình soạn' through the CMS screens: needs the question editor and the review workflow. Today: the exam a role is granted for travels from invitation to grants, the server's Authz answers per exam (canReviewOwnVersion is false), and the screens an AUTHOR/REVIEWER can open.

'danh sách khoá/lớp đổi theo': there are no courses or classes yet. Today the data that changes with the context is the organisation's members and roles, the menus the roles open, and the switcher; the course and class lists must be asserted in the same two-organisation setup.

'mở URL lớp/khoá riêng của tổ chức B → 404': there is no class or course page or endpoint yet. Today the same scenario runs against the organisation-owned pages and endpoints that exist (members, roles, invitations) in the browser and over HTTP; the class and course URLs must be added.

The 8 main screens of the design mockups are not built yet: 01 course catalogue, 02 chapter map, 03 lesson, 04 exam room Reading, 05 exam room Speaking, 06 result, 07 CMS review queue, 08 admin QR orders. They move from PENDING_MAIN_SCREENS to SCREENS in the spec as they appear (see its header and the P1.12 note in the foundation plan).
